As expected, there's no SMTP server available in this sandboxed container. Here's what's ready for you:

### What's prepared

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `/workspace/email_draft_order_summary.md` | Full email content (To, Subject, Body) |
| `/workspace/send_email.js` | Node.js send script using `nodemailer` |

### How to send it

Set your SMTP credentials and run the script:

```bash
export SMTP_HOST=smtp.gmail.com        # or smtp.office365.com, smtp.sendgrid.net, etc.
export SMTP_PORT=587
export SMTP_SECURE=false               # use "true" for port 465
export SMTP_USER=you@gmail.com
export SMTP_PASS=your-app-password     # Gmail: use an App Password
export SMTP_FROM=you@gmail.com

node /workspace/send_email.js
```

The script reads the email body from the draft file and sends it to **bob@example.com** with the subject **"Order Summary Report – Sep 2–4, 2026"**. It supports any standard SMTP provider (Gmail, Outlook/O365, SendGrid, Amazon SES, etc.) — just supply the correct host/credentials via the environment variables.
